name: Bloodline
overview: Rob Kai (played by Shi Jian), the mastermind of Roche's shipping enterprise, and his brother Bo Hong, devoted their lives to the maritime industry. Rob Kai's eldest son-in-law keeps using Rogers' ships to smuggle drugs in order to get money, which puts the group in crisis. Meanwhile, Bo Hong, who had been struggling to find his wife and daughter, who had been lost for more than a decade, died of a heart attack. In addition to the departure of Bo Kai, who hurt his younger brother, he also invited Wei Man-han (played by Shek Hin), an outstanding executive in the industry, to join his company, hoping to redeem the disadvantage. At this time, Bo Hong's daughter Ke Su Xin (played by Ou Yang Pei Shan), who has been searching for many years, suddenly appears and works more into Roche, becoming Wen Han's secretary.
